entities.summary: Hellmuth Becker was a German SS commander during the Nazi era. In World War II, he led the SS Division Totenkopf from 1944 and was a recipient of the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross with Oak Leaves. Post-war, Becker was tried by Soviet authorities twice, first for war crimes and then for sabotage and was executed in 1953, after the second trial.
